submission.reason: Exploration of data/explore.csv showed only potassium_ppm had a nominally significant farm-adjusted association with yield_kg (coef ~ -0.33, p ~ 0.017-0.021), so it was chosen as the single candidate. The pre-registered confirmatory OLS on held-out data (outcome ~ potassium_ppm + farm indicators) gave estimate 0.014, SE 0.122, p = 0.909, which is not significant at alpha = 0.05. The exploratory signal did not replicate, so no exposure is confirmed to have a direct effect.
